audio.title: Beau Sandland Conference Call
audio.desc: Seventh-round draft choice says he is a complete tight end who can run counter one play and a route the next play.

audio.title: Zack Sanchez Conference Call
audio.desc: Fifth-round draft choice says he was born with the ability to make plays and nobody can create turnovers the way he can.

audio.title: Daryl Worley Conference Call
audio.desc: Third-round draft choice says he likes to play aggressively and thinks his skills will be a good fit in the Panthers' attack-style defense.

audio.title: James Bradberry Conference Call
audio.desc: Second-round draft choice says strengths are his his physicality and technique in press coverage, ability to recognize routes in zone coverage and tackling.

audio.title: Vernon Butler Conference Call
audio.desc: First-round draft choice describes himself as an aggressive player who likes to penetrate and make plays in the backfield.

audio.title: Rashad Johnson Conference Call
audio.desc: Arizona Cardinals safety says Panthers quarterback Cam Newton presents several challenges with his ability to make plays with his arm and legs.

audio.title: Pete Carroll Conference Call
audio.desc: Seattle head coach says Carolina's offense is the most diversified offense the Seahawks have played, making the Panthers very difficult to prepare for.

audio.title: Russell Wilson Conference Call
audio.desc: Seattle Seahawks quarterback says the Panthers defense is as good as it gets, even with the changes in the secondary, and you really respect who they are.

audio.title: Lovie Smith Conference Call
audio.desc: Tampa Bay head coach says the Buccaneers have just as much to play for in the regular season finale as the Panthers do.

audio.title: Gerald McCoy Conference Call
audio.desc: Tampa Bay defensive tackle says the Buccaneers need to get after quarterback Cam Newton, who is in his opinion the NFL MVP because of what he's done with who he has.

audio.title: Dan Quinn Conference Call
audio.desc: Atlanta head coach says the Falcons are jacked to be playing the undefeated Panthers for the second time in three weeks with their playoff hopes still alive.

audio.title: Matt Ryan Conference Call
audio.desc: Atlanta quarterback says Panthers cornerback Josh Norman is a great competitor to go against but Falcons have an equal counterpart in wide receiver Julio Jones.

audio.title: Tom Coughlin Conference Call
audio.desc: New York head coach says Carolina general manager and former Giants director of pro personnel Dave Gettleman has done an outstanding job building the Panthers.

audio.title: Eli Manning Conference Call
audio.desc: New York Giants quarterback says game against Carolina is more about their quest to make the playoffs than about taking down the undefeated Panthers.

audio.title: Dan Quinn Conference Call
audio.desc: Atlanta Falcons head coach remembers games against Panthers in 2013 and 2014 when he was Seattle Seahawks defensive coordinator as absolute battles and says he studied them in preparation for this week.

audio.title: Julio Jones Conference Call
audio.desc: Atlanta Falcons wide receiver says Panthers cornerback Josh Norman can do it all, but he is treating their matchup just like any other one.

audio.title: Drew Brees Conference Call
audio.desc: New Orleans Saints quarterback says Panthers cornerback Josh Norman is as complete a cornerback as there is in the NFL and deserves to be in consideration for defensive player of the year.

audio.title: Sean Payton Conference Call
audio.desc: New Orleans Saints head coach says the Panthers' ability to create takeaways and convert those turnovers into points has a lot to do with why they are unbeaten.

audio.title: Tony Romo Conference Call
audio.desc: Dallas Cowboys quarterback, back in the lineup after missing seven games with an injury, says the Panthers are the best team in the NFC if not all of football.

audio.title: Jason Garrett Conference Call
audio.desc: Dallas head coach says game not about defensive end Greg Hardy playing his former team but about the Cowboys and Panthers.

audio.title: Jay Gruden Conference Call
audio.desc: Washington Redskins head coach says the Panthers are undefeated for a reason - the offense keeps opponents off balance and the defense is sound in what it does.

audio.title: Kirk Cousins Conference Call
audio.desc: Washington Redskins quarterback is not surprised by Josh Norman's impact on the Panthers' defense, having trained with the cornerback for several months before the 2012 NFL Draft.

audio.title: Mike Mularkey Conference Call
audio.desc: Tennessee Titans head coach says the Panthers have a lot of good players and is a little worried about matching up with them.

audio.title: Brian Orakpo Conference Call
audio.desc: Tennessee having success pressuring the quarterback this season, but linebacker says Titans will have their hands full bringing down an elusive passer in Cam Newton.

audio.title: Aaron Rodgers Conference Call
audio.desc: Green Bay Packers quarterback says the Panthers' defense has cornerback Josh Norman and is playing more consistent than when the two teams met last season.

audio.title: Mike McCarthy Conference Call
audio.desc: Green Bay Packers head coach says there is not a quarterback in the NFL who does more from the position than Cam Newton.

audio.title: Chuck Pagano Conference Call
audio.desc: Indianapolis Colts head coach says Panthers quarterback Cam Newton is a rare talent who is a nightmare running and throwing the football.

audio.title: Andrew Luck Conference Call
audio.desc: Quarterback says limiting negative plays and taking care of the football will be keys to success for the Colts against Panthers defense that is "doing everything well."

audio.title: Connor Barwin Conference Call
audio.desc: Philadelphia linebacker spied quarterback Cam Newton and recorded 3.5 sacks in Eagles win over Panthers last season.

audio.title: Chip Kelly Conference Call
audio.desc: Philadelphia head coach says the Panthers, and specifically quarterback Cam Newton, aren't the same team the Eagles defeated 45-21 last season.

audio.title: Pete Carroll Conference Call
audio.desc: Seattle Seahawks head coach says running back Marshawn Lynch looks like he will be ready to play against Carolina after missing the last two games.

audio.title: Russell Wilson Conference Call
audio.desc: Seattle Seahawks quarterback says Panthers rookie linebacker Shaq Thompson was a superstar at the University of Washington and was unbelievable to watch.

audio.title: Lovie Smith Conference Call
audio.desc: Tampa Bay Buccaneers head coach says Jared Allen knows how to get to the quarterback, calls Cam Newton one of the best quarterbacks in the NFL, period.

audio.title: Jameis Winston Conference Call
audio.desc: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback is taking his rookie season week-by-week, will miss playing against former Florida State teammate Kelvin Benjamin.
